feeds.title: The Art of Film Funding
feeds.description: Discover the secrets to funding and creating successful indie films with The Art of Film Funding Podcast.  Join Carole Dean, President of From the Heart Productions and author of The Art of Film Funding, and Heather Lenz, director of the award-winning documentary Kusama-Infinity, as they chat with top film industry pros. Get practical insider tips on crowdfunding, pitching, saving on budgets, marketing, hybrid distribution, and the latest in A.I. filmmaking. Whether you're funding your first project or navigating new trends, this podcast has everything you need to succeed...
